extracted.name: Crunchy noodle salad
extracted.description: Make our noodle salad for a light lunch or side – toasted dried noodles are combined with fresh veg and citrus to make this satisfying recipe
ingredient_lines: 1 avocado peeled, halved, destoned and diced
¼ small red cabbage finely sliced
instruction_lines: Break up the noodles into small pieces and tip into a dry frying pan over a medium heat. Toast for 1-2 mins until slightly golden. Remove from the heat and set aside.
Combine both oils, the vinegar, soy sauce and maple syrup in a large bowl and season. Toss in the rest of the salad ingredients, along with the toasted noodles. Serve immediately.
